summary: A hand-entered dataset that is still empty can now be told to keep its figures at a finer period than the one it is shown at.
details: The save of a dataset whose file holds nothing accepts the period its data should be kept at, so a triangle displayed a year at a time can hold monthly figures underneath, the way ResQ's own editing dialog allows.
The period asked for has to divide the one on screen, and once the dataset holds figures it can no longer be moved; both refusals name the reason.
A vector has no such setting, as in ResQ, and ignores it.
The screen control that offers this arrives with the next step of the work; nothing changes for anyone yet.
